summary: The Efficient Column Updates sync on 16 June 2026 covered the base file definition in V4 metadata, the implementation path, and two column update details. Representing the base file was called the primary blocker, with two options: a special entity separate from the ColumnFile list (the current proposal in Gábor's PR) or just another ColumnFile. Steven's upcoming PR overriding apply in SnapshotProducer was identified as the change that unblocks V4 development, which will target the generics API. The notes state that per-column stats updates are an implementation detail and that partition column updates are allowed in V4.

topics.title: V4 metadata: base file definition
topics.summary: The primary blocker for V4 metadata is how to represent the base file. Option 1, the current proposal in Gábor's PR, treats the base file as a special entity: TrackedFile holds its metadata (location, size, split offsets) separately from a list of ColumnFile objects, which keeps the base-file-plus-updates mental model and uses the base file location as the identifier of the logical file, avoiding a new file ID. Option 2 treats the base file as just another ColumnFile, for a simpler and more consistent model; its proponents consider the split-offset-based reader logic inefficient and historically broken, and so a weak argument for the current approach. The notes record no choice.
open_questions: Should the base file be a special entity in TrackedFile or just another ColumnFile?

topics.title: V4 implementation path
topics.summary: The blocker is serializing V4 structures on the write path. Steven's upcoming PR overrides the apply method in SnapshotProducer, adding a V4-specific path that converts operations into tracking file entries and writes a root manifest instead of a manifest list; the notes call it the key to unblocking all later V4 development. Development will target the generics API, which allows rapid prototyping and unit testing without the complexities of Spark integration such as waiting for Spark 4.3, and which depends on Steven's PR being merged first.
decisions: The development target for column updates is the generics API, after Steven's SnapshotProducer PR is merged.

topics.title: Column update details: stats and partition columns
topics.summary: Two details are recorded. Whether to update stats only for modified columns or rewrite all stats is an implementation detail, not a spec requirement, because the best strategy depends on how many columns are updated and the cost of managing multiple stat entries. Updates to partition columns are allowed in V4, because V4 plans to drop partition tuples from file metadata and plan only on min/max stats for partition transforms.
decisions: Updating stats for only the modified columns versus rewriting all stats is an implementation detail, not a spec requirement.
Partition column updates are allowed in V4.
